The separate contribution Upload flow sends an image privately to Cloudflare R2 for sanitization and review; Supabase stores account and contribution metadata, not artwork files. Original quarantine uploads expire after processing or cleanup; sanitized files remain private until approval. We do not request geolocation, fingerprint devices or assign tracking identifiers. Application rate limits store only salted, daily-rotating hashes, removed after expiry; infrastructure-provider logging needs owner review.

strings.Guest contributions do not create an acc: Guest contributions do not create an account. We store the artwork, review details and any optional contact or UPI fields you choose to provide. Each field is published only with its own explicit consent. A private status link contains a random secret in its URL fragment; only a hash is stored in the database. Anyone holding the link can read that submission's status and feedback. Links expire after 90 days; scheduled cleanup removes expired receipt/contact records and abandoned draft files. Submitted artwork remains subject to review and the takedown policy. Save the link yourself: we do not email it or save it in localStorage.
